constraints.name: contracts_company_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fk_contracts_order
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, order_id) REFERENCES orders(company_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: trg_contracts_immutability
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_contracts_immutability BEFORE UPDATE ON contracts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_contracts_immutability()

triggers.name: trg_tenant_mutation_contracts
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_tenant_mutation_contracts BEFORE UPDATE ON contracts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_tenant_mutation()

triggers.name: trg_updated_at_contracts
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_updated_at_contracts BEFORE UPDATE ON contracts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()

indexes.name: contracts_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX contracts_pkey ON public.contracts USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_contracts_status
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_contracts_status ON public.contracts USING btree (company_id, status)

indexes.name: uq_contracts_order_current
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_contracts_order_current ON public.contracts USING btree (order_id) WHERE (is_current = true)

indexes.name: uq_contracts_order_revision
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_contracts_order_revision ON public.contracts USING btree (order_id, revision_no)
